tools.name: time_series_injury_aggregator_20260401_193735
tools.description: This tool generates a monthly trend of total injuries from January to March across all years. It loads data, processes dates, aggregates injury counts by month, and visualizes the trend with a line plot.
tools.user_query: Show monthly trend of total injuries from Jan to Mar for all the years. Generate the plots as well.
